title: Relative affine morphism classification and coordinate compatibility after base change
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $B$ a commutative $R$-algebra with structure map $i:R\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $Q=\operatorname{Spec}B\to V$ the morphism induced by $i$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every scheme $s:U\to V$ [def-pc-scheme], use $s^\sharp$ for the $R$-algebra structure on $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Pullback of sections induces a bijection
$$E_U:\operatorname{Mor}_V(U,Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(B,\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)),\qquad E_U(a)(b)=a^\sharp(b).$$
Here $b\in B$ is identified with its global section on $Q$. For every $h:U_1\to U_2$ over $V$, $E_{U_1}(a\circ h)=h^\sharp\circ E_{U_2}(a)$.
For every morphism $v:V'\to V$, put $Q'=V'\times_VQ$ with projection $p:Q'\to Q$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $V'$-scheme $U$, regarded as a $V$-scheme through $v$, there is a bijection
$$E^v_U:\operatorname{Mor}_{V'}(U,Q')\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(B,\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)),\qquad E^v_U(a)(b)=a^\sharp(p^\sharp b),$$
natural in $U$ by the same precomposition formula. If $a:U\to Q$ is over $V$, $U'=V'\times_VU$ has projection $r:U'\to U$, and $a':U'\to Q'$ is the induced morphism, then
$$E^v_{U'}(a')=r^\sharp\circ E_U(a).$$
Neither $U$ nor $V'$ is required to be affine.
